userAuthorization.scope: Operate the four exact UI governance routes and superseded PRs when required by project rules

supersededHistoricalEvidence.reason: Current main independently changed the same routing policy and shared routing test while installing OSS-A exact authority paths. The old branches therefore remain evidence only.

implementation.requiredBase: the exact main merge commit containing this authorization

mandatoryRedContracts: All four exact UI governance paths together select GOVERNANCE_WP0
Each exact UI governance path independently selects GOVERNANCE_WP0
Any exact UI governance path mixed with product source selects PRODUCT_WP0 and records both governance and product classes
Any exact UI governance path mixed with PRODUCT_DOCUMENTATION_WP0 Markdown selects PRODUCT_WP0 and records governance, product-documentation and escalation
The existing OSS-A exact governance paths remain GOVERNANCE_WP0
Pure Superpowers plan/spec Markdown remains non-executable PRODUCT_DOCUMENTATION_WP0
Unknown and invalid paths remain fail closed
schemaVersion remains 2 and readyForPromotion remains false
requiredSequence: Authorization exact Head passes all applicable gates
Independent review returns ALLOW with zero P0 and P1 blockers
Authorization PR merges to current main without rebase, squash, force push or history rewrite
Implementation branch is created from that exact main commit
Independent test file is committed first and produces causal RED
Only the four literal paths are added to governanceExactPaths
Implementation exact Head passes all applicable gates and independent review
Implementation PR merges to main only if main has not changed the authorized files or a new authorization is issued
